svg.text: Python at the edges, Node-RED in the middle, MQTT connects everything. No service knows another one directly – they only communicate via topics.
Birth · Close · Last Will per connection
● retained: the broker keeps the latest value
bike time, elevation, walking, transit estimate
planned → from 30 min before: bike ok / warning / unknown
commuter wave, centre vs outskirts, weather & use
4 pages: route overview, statistics, manage routes, system
Last Will: the broker publishes "offline (crashed)" if a connection drops without DISCONNECT
The recommendation is only given 30 min before departure; before that the route is "planned" (bike time, weather preview, bus comparison).
Transit time: EMT timetable (direct lines) → EMT live arrivals when available → estimate if there is no direct line.
